description: Search the FULL WebCake backend API (675 operations the storefront account can call — far more than the dedicated tools cover). With `query`: one line per match `id — Controller.action (body/query keys, * = required) ⇒ tool: dedicated tool if one exists`. With `id`: the call sheet (path params, body/query keys with their nested fields, required keys, permission needed). Prefer a dedicated tool when one is listed; use api_get / api_call for the rest.

id.description: Exact operation id from a previous search, e.g. 'post:/api/v1/dashboard/site/:site_id/products/create'

query.description: English keywords from the path/controller, e.g. 'shipping fee', 'product tag', 'customer point'

name: api_find
